component.name: Purpose
component.summary: Scientific monograph & technical dispatch desktop editor

description.p: Purpose is a dedicated desktop editor for The Technical Dispatch & Notebook. Craft Markdown and MDX monographs, manage engineering notes, preview mathematical equations and technical plots, and publish directly through Git.

Purpose 0.2.0 major overhaul: archival book paper light mode default, dark mode toggle, multi-package manager support (Bun, PNPM, Yarn, npm), real schema extraction from content.config.ts, streaming command output with cancellation, draft autosave recovery, external modification conflict resolution modal, OS trash integration, and 60fps deferred preview rendering.
